text: dsh-chatmode 是 DSH 的聊天模式扩展，通过 bundle 注册“聊天模式”预设，并在运行时不挂载工具、屏蔽全局工具。它在会话中发布一次可调用技能目录，用户输入 /skill-name 时把对应技能说明注入当前步骤。适合希望在 DSH 中进行单轮、类似网页聊天的文字问答，同时按需引用技能说明的用户。代码未声明外部服务或密钥要求。

dsh-chatmode adds a DSH chat preset with no tools and single-pass replies. It publishes a skill catalog once per session and injects a skill’s instructions when the user types /skill-name. No API key or external service is declared.
想让 DSH 像网页聊天一样只回答一轮，不要调用工具。
在 DSH 的聊天模式里，怎么通过输入技能名称来使用已有 Skill？
Can I use a DSH chat preset that hides tools but still lets me invoke a skill by name?
dsh-chatmode 的功能「聊天模式下按需注入技能」：模式首次满足条件时会向会话添加技能目录；用户消息中出现 /skill-name 时，插件读取用户可调用的技能并将其说明注入当前步骤。
dsh-chatmode 的维护与更新元数据：活跃维护；距最后推送 21 天；提交数 2；更新频次 unknown；近 90 天提交 未知；开放 Issue 未知；仓库健康分 62/100（置信度 low）。

[](https://github.com/xystudio889/dsh-chatmode)

A DeepSeek Harness extension that adds a new **Chat mode**.

> **Author's note:** This project was developed entirely by DeepSeek Harness AI, and the code is fully AI-generated. If you find a bug, please report it.

dsh-chatmode README · dsh-chatmode - A web-like minimalist experience：> Your Skills are preserved, but the model won't perform any actions, and a single thinking pass produces the answer. This gives a web-chat-like experience and saves a lot of tokens.

dsh-chatmode README · What this mode does：- **No tools at all**: the mode mounts no tool plugins (read / write / bash / pwsh / web / todo / subagent / goal / plan — none of them), and it hides host-globally-mounted tools within the mode's scope. The tool schema list the model receives is empty.
- **The loop naturally converges to a single pass**: no tools means no tool-call turns, so DSH's agent loop ends the turn right after the model's first reply (one thinking pass, a single answer). It won't continue for multiple steps just to perform actions.
- **Skills are still kept**:
  - Each session receives a one-time skill catalog message (skill name + description, for skills within the model's callable scope) telling the model it cannot load skills by itself.
  - When the user writes `/skill-name` in the input, that skill's full `<skill_content>` body is injected automatically in the same step, and the model answers directly according to the skill instructions — no `skill` tool needed, and no second generation pass.
- **Lean prompt**: `persona` uses `complete: true` and `includeRuntimeContext: false`, so the system prompt keeps only the chat-mode persona and drops sections such as the
dsh-chatmode README · Installation：```powershell

dsh-chatmode README · Install the local directory from the DSH Web UI "Plugins" page, or:：dsh plugin --profile <profile> add F:\code\dsh-plugin\dsh-chatmode
```

You can also install this directory with `plugin_manager` in any DSH profile (in addition to `cordis.patch.yml`); the bundle patch inserts the mode declaration automatically.

Once installed, "聊天模式" (Chat mode) appears in **Settings → Modes** (or in the mode selector of a new session). Select it for a new session, or switch an empty session to it.

text:
dsh-chatmode README · Mode definition：`cordis.patch.yml` inserts one declaration line into `@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset`:

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| `id` | `chatmode` |
| Name | `聊天模式` |
| Description | See above |
| Composition | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-persona` (chat-mode persona) + `dsh-chatmode` (this package's runtime code) |

This package registers no tools; the runtime code does only two things: publish the skill catalog / inject `/skill-name` bodies, and hide global tools within the mode's scope.

dsh-chatmode README · Runtime implementation：- `ctx.inject(['tools'])`: listens to `tools/change`, registers the current global tool names as a `deny` list via `ctx.tools.restrict()`, and refreshes as global tools are added or removed; tools inside the mode scope are always empty.
- `ctx.inject(['skills', 'workingDirectory'])`: listens to `agent/pre-step` and, on accepted steps, appends the one-time skill catalog message and the skill body injected by `/skill-name`. All failures are swallowed and logged as warnings, so they never turn a conversation turn into a failed turn.

dsh-chatmode README · Runtime implementation：It depends on no `@deepseek-ai/*` runtime packages (profile-installed bundles cannot resolve them); model-visible formats such as message construction and `<skill_content>` rendering are self-contained in this package and stay consistent with the official `dsh-tool-skill` / `dsh-skill`.

dsh-chatmode README · Display metadata and language：- Bundle titles and descriptions on the plugin/settings page come from `locale/*.json` and switch with the software language: `locale/en.json` contains only English (`Chat mode` + English description), and `locale/zh.json` contains only Chinese (`聊天模式` + Chinese description).
- The name and description in the mode selector come from the preset declaration in `cordis.patch.yml`, which is a **single string** returned by the host and does not participate in client-side localization: DSH client's `presetDisplayText` only uses localized entries for built-in modes (standard / ptc / minimal / cordis), and custom modes display the declared `name`/`description` verbatim (official note: *without making user-authored metadata translatable*).
- Therefore a custom mode cannot achieve "Chinese UI shows Chinese, English UI shows English". As required, this package sets the mode name/description to **Chinese only**: `name: '聊天模式'`, with the Chinese sentence above as the description. To make it English-only instead, simply change the corresponding text in `cordis.patch.yml` and `package.json`; true per-language switching would require a client UI
dsh-chatmode README · Verified：After installing into the current desktop profile, the real runtime state was read through a temporary probe inside the host:

dsh-chatmode README · Verified：- The mode is in the roster: `chatmode` (name, description, order=5), with no `broken` diagnostics.
- The mode composition is mounted and both rows are active: `@deepseek-ai/dsh-persona` + `dsh-chatmode`.
- Within the chat-mode scope the visible tool list is empty (globally mounted Agent Teams tools are hidden too), the system prompt contains only the chat-mode persona (`complete: true`), and optional runtime context is disabled.

dsh-chatmode README · Verified：Logic such as `/skill-name` injection and the catalog being published only once is covered by `test/plugin.test.mjs` in an offline fake context. The actual conversational feel (whether answers feel like web chat) still needs to be confirmed by the user after selecting "聊天模式" in a new session.

dsh-chatmode README · Limitations：- The model cannot choose skills on its own: it only sees the skill catalog, and the user triggers body injection with `/skill-name`. This is the trade-off under the "zero tools + single-pass generation" constraint.
- Existing sessions switched from another mode to this one may still carry old skill-catalog messages in their history (prompting the model to call the `skill` tool); this mode does not rewrite history messages. Starting a new session is recommended to experience chat mode.
- The skill catalog is published only once per session; changes to skill files within a session are not re-sent automatically (this mode mounts no compaction/refresh plugins).
- The host must already have the `skills` service and skill providers mounted (the desktop default composition satisfies this); when missing, the skill catalog and `/skill-name` injection are skipped automatically and the mode still chats normally.

dsh-chatmode README · Development：```powershell
node --check index.js
node test/plugin.test.mjs
```

`test/plugin.test.mjs` uses a fake Cordis context to cover: registering no tools, hiding global tools, publishing the catalog only once, `/skill-name` injection, and returning `reject` decisions unchanged.
